translate_en|mods/HugThePlushie/42/media:
All unhappiness and stress you gain from any sources while hugging is multiplied by this.

i.e. 0.2 means you get 80%% less stressed and unhappy while hugging.

Whether just holding a plushie in your hand, having it equipped on you or attached to your backpack, has a passive effect.
Doesn't stack with multiple plushies and doesn't apply when you're hugging a plushie.

All unhappiness and stress you gain from any sources while holding a plushie is multiplied by this.

i.e. 0.85 means you get 15%% less stressed and unhappy while holding a plushie.

If "Stress Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum stress below which holding a plushie won't reduce stress.
Otherwise, this is the maximum stress above which holding a plushie won't add stress.

How much stress to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're holding a plushie.
Note that nicotine stress isn't affected.

If "Unhappiness Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum unhappiness below which holding a plushie won't reduce unhappiness.
Otherwise, this is the maximum unhappiness above which holding a plushie won't add unhappiness.
How much unhappiness to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're holding a plushie.

If "Stress Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum stress below which hugging a plushie won't reduce stress.
Otherwise, this is the maximum stress above which hugging a plushie won't add stress.

How much stress to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're hugging a plushie.
Note that nicotine stress isn't affected.

If "Unhappiness Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum unhappiness below which hugging a plushie won't reduce unhappiness.
Otherwise, this is the maximum unhappiness above which hugging a plushie won't add unhappiness.
How much unhappiness to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're hugging a plushie.
